tg_guide_text:
• Use a Secondary / Burner Account: Never use your primary personal Telegram account (with family & friends) for mass downloading. Keep them separate.
• Warm Up Fresh Accounts: Accounts registered within the last few weeks with virtual/VoIP numbers have zero trust score. Let new accounts age and participate in normal chat activity first.
• Never Scrape Members: Telegram issues instant bans to automated scrapers that harvest user lists or send mass DMs. Pawchive only reads media attachments.
• Respect Cooldowns: When Telegram asks to wait ('FloodWait'), Pawchive automatically sleeps and resumes. Never try to bypass rate-limit timers.

tip_date_from: Earliest date to include. Supports a full year (e.g. 2024 starts Jan 1), month (2024-06 starts 1st), or exact day.
tip_date_to: Latest date to include. Supports a full year (e.g. 2024 ends Dec 31), month (2024-06 ends June 30), or exact day.
tip_export_queue: Export queue snapshot with progress and settings to a backup JSON file
tip_filename_pattern: Choose how downloaded files are named and organized on your disk
tip_import_queue: Load a saved queue backup file (Merge or Replace)
tip_pre_extracted: This archive was already extracted before scanning. Select it and re-run to overwrite.
tip_probe_health: Checks link status (Mega, Pixeldrain, GoFile, Catbox) asynchronously in background
tip_scroll_tabs_left: Scroll tabs left (or use mouse wheel)
tip_scroll_tabs_right: Scroll tabs right (or use mouse wheel)
tip_send_passwords: Adds all extracted passwords to Bulk Decompressor archive dictionary
tip_size_max: Maximum file size. Files larger than this will be skipped before downloading.
tip_size_min: Minimum file size. Files smaller than this will be skipped before downloading.
tip_t2_optional: Optional in 'Semantic Matcher Only' mode. Deep Context Reasoner SLM is only used when 'Full Hybrid' mode is active.
tip_template_input: Enter custom pattern using tags below. Preview updates in real-time.
tip_tg_disabled: Direct download is disabled for Telegram links. Please click 'Select Posts…' to configure download scope and media filters.
tip_thread_tg_locked: Telegram Lock: Concurrency is locked to 2 threads to prevent FloodWait bans and connection drops.
tip_tutorial: Open interactive tutorial and feature manual
tip_update_pill: New version detected on GitHub — click to download and install
tooltip_skip_words_size: Skip specific words or filter by file size! Use [1GB-2GB], [>=1GB], [<500MB], or [1024-2048] (in MB)
watchlist_add_artist_tip: Track an artist by URL without downloading past posts
watchlist_add_desc: Track an artist to automatically check for future posts without downloading their full past catalog.
watchlist_add_folder_ph: Leave empty for default download folder
watchlist_add_path_tip: Link another folder or drive as an additional location for this artist
watchlist_browse_tip: Change download folder for this artist
folder_change_body: %1 file(s) (%2) are already downloaded in the current folder. Move them to the new folder too?
folder_change_note: Moving keeps sub-folders and never overwrites a file: same files are merged, different ones with the same name are kept as "name (2)". With the download archive on, its records follow the files.
folder_change_new_only_tip: Files stay where they are and are still recognised; new downloads go to the new folder
watchlist_check_all_tip: Check all followed artists for new posts
watchlist_stop_check_tip: Stop checking (the next check continues from here)
watchlist_download_all_tip: Download all newly discovered posts for all creators in your watchlist
watchlist_edit_date_tip:
Click to modify last downloaded cutoff date
Enforces/converts to YYYY-MM-DD for Pawchive and cum.st
watchlist_error_invalid_url: Invalid URL or creator could not be resolved.
watchlist_ignore_all_tip: Permanently skip all currently discovered posts (future new posts will still be detected)
watchlist_no_matches: No artists match your search or filter
watchlist_open_folder_tip: Click to open folder in File Explorer
watchlist_redownload_tip: Re-queue the entire artist's catalog for download
watchlist_remove_tip: Stop tracking this artist and remove from watchlist
watchlist_review_tip: Review, selectively download, or ignore specific new posts
watchlist_show_gallery_tip: Show this folder in the Gallery
watchlist_skip_post_tip: Permanently ignore this post (won't be downloaded)
watchlist_toggle_review_tip: Click to review individual new posts
watchlist_unignore_tip: Click to reset ignored posts and re-check for updates
opt_file_order_tip:
Which file of a post comes first: it is downloaded first and gets #1 with the index prefix and numbered file names.

As posted: the order the site shows.
Reversed: for creators who upload the newest version first.
By file name: sorted by name with numbers counted properly (2 before 10), in any language.
tip_file_order_modal: Order of the files: #1 is downloaded first and numbered first. This is the "File order in posts" setting from the Downloader tab.
scheduler_night_owl_hint: Schedules only start inside this window. A download that's already running keeps going after the window ends.
webp_quality_tip: How strongly pictures are compressed. Lossless keeps every pixel; Balanced is barely visible and much smaller; Small and Smallest save the most space. A picture is kept as it was if the WebP wouldn't be smaller.
toast_archive_damaged: The archive database is damaged. It's being repaired now; try again in a moment.
toast_archive_repaired: The archive database was damaged and has been repaired (%1 records kept). You can try again now.
toast_archive_repair_failed: The archive database is damaged and couldn't be repaired: %1
